title: Product Manager, Growth
description:
Nexus Commerce is a Series B e-commerce platform serving 5,000+ SMB merchants. We're growing our product team and looking for a PM to own our growth and activation surface.

About the role:
- Own user activation, onboarding, and self-serve upgrade flows
- Design and run A/B experiments to improve conversion and retention
- Work with Growth Engineering and Marketing on top-of-funnel improvements
- Use data to identify drop-off points and prioritize interventions
- Partner with Sales on SMB customer feedback loops

What we need:
- 5+ years of product management experience
- Strong track record with growth metrics — activation, retention, conversion
- Comfortable running A/B tests and interpreting results
- Experience with SMB or consumer-facing products
- Collaborative style with Sales and Marketing
- Remote OK, US timezones preferred

Nice to have:
- Experience at a marketplace or commerce platform
- Familiarity with PLG (product-led growth) motions
- Pricing experimentation experience

Comp range: $150k-$180k + equity
